status_definitions.known: O explicitly encodes or discusses materially the same idea, but no direct behavioral measurement of the clean candidate's mechanism/scope was found.
status_definitions.evaluated: O has a direct explicit experiment/evidence record on substantially the same mechanism under a named matched scope.
status_definitions.partially_tested: O has measured or implemented a related adaptation/submechanism, but not the clean candidate's full mechanism or transfer scope.
status_definitions.uncovered: No materially equivalent mechanism or direct test was found in the inspected current O snapshot; generic adjacent infrastructure does not count.

state_chain.resolution_rule: The effective clean novelty state is the complete predecessor state chain plus the named current delta. Add current new_assessments; apply scope_updates and candidate_reconciliations without double-counting semantically identical source updates. No prior clean assessment is discarded.

o_snapshot.novelty_relevant_delta: O main is unchanged from the predecessor snapshot. Configured, scheduled, frozen or pending work was not counted as executed/evaluated evidence.

summary.candidate_counting_note: The predecessor's 149 clean semantic instances remain intact. This run adds 30 materially new source-bound semantic instances. FE-023 is reconciled to FE-017; self-improvement C9 to C7; self-improvement C11 to C1. These current clean candidates remain classified through their canonical instances and are not double-counted.
summary.note_on_zero_evaluated: No clean semantic candidate matches a completed O experiment closely enough in full mechanism and tested scope to be called directly evaluated. Related implemented or measured submechanisms are classified partially_tested; generic adjacency alone is uncovered. Narrow O-adapted failures remain confined to exact tested scope.

scientist_agents.identity_warning: Preserve predecessor source-bound semantic identities where raw worker IDs were reused.

comparison_guards: Status applies only to the exact clean semantic candidate instance and stated source scope/configuration/metric/date.
An O-adapted failure never counts as rejection of an original external method/family unless direct evidence supports that exact broader inference.
Configured, scheduled, frozen or pending O work is not treated as executed/evaluated evidence.
Generic adjacent infrastructure does not count as evaluated evidence; partial status requires an implemented or measured related submechanism.
Current clean candidate IDs that restate an already represented semantic mechanism are retained as candidate reconciliations/scope updates rather than silently dropped or double-counted.
Candidate/source provenance and uncertainty are retained in predecessor records and the named current delta; no judgment was written to exploration workers.
